'''Kurt Schlichting The Bith Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Kurt Schlichting]]
* '''Published:''' April 1997 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Hoth]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Dune Sea|Premiere-L-tatooinedunesea.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' The Bith Deck
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PHoth The Bith Deck Schlichting LS 1997.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

First off, I want to make it clear that this is not a tournament winning deck! It's a Theme deck built around the Bith characters from the Cantina. There are a few great combos, but they're tough to get out, so it's more of a fun deck than anything. Most of them are linked somehow to the Cantina and Tatooine.

== Strategy ==

The main combos in this deck are:

If you can get both of these combos out relatively early in the game, you should have no problems.

Watch out for Dark Space decks! The last thing you want is to let the Dark side control Clak'Dor, so if you're not sure you can defend it, don't even put it out. Rather, concentrate on getting big force drains on Tatooine, and don't confront his spaceships unless you have to.

The main reason I included Sense and Alter (I hate both of these cards) is to protect the Bacta Tank, Nightfall and the Memorial. I also threw in For Luck, which is optional, but I think it can realy help. Don't use the the Sense and Alter for anything else unless you have no choice!

All in all, it's a fun deck to play with. When it works, it kicks butt, when it doesn't, well...you get the picture. E-mail me with any comments'suggestions!
